text: Does your team teach its assistants the same lesson again and again? Four people, four assistants, the same correction.
Even solo, Sensei follows a constitution: your rules. You can add proven rule packs for security, testing, or a lighter way of coding.
When a rule works for you, share it with your dōjō, on your terms. You see what would leave, anonymised, and confirm.
Contributions gather into one candidate. Maintainers triage and approve it, then it goes out to the team.
It reaches everyone as an upgrade. Each person can apply it, mute it, or pin it.
Sign in once, and the right rules follow you into every repository. Preview which rules govern a project, and why, before the first commit.
Sensei. Learn it once. The team keeps it.
